verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line naming a 'Devin Review' feature with Auto-Fix, which flags bugs and responds to code review comments. That implies an AI review capability exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it runs automatically on every pull request or posts inline comments, and the line mainly describes Devin reacting to review comments rather than writing them. Missing for 10: documented automatic review triggered on every PR, evidence of AI-generated inline comments, configuration or scope details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
